hypothesis: The selected structured E5 query's additional BM25-union coverage can be ranked into the official Top-10 by applying the frozen fold-local champion quality and two-feature linear ranker to the complete sparse-first candidate union.

candidate.union_order: all sparse candidates first, then unseen dense candidates
candidate.linear_models: existing phase20 feature_quality fold-local weights; no refit or tuning

all_required: OOF technical-score delta versus fold-local champion >= 0.005
session-reward delta is non-negative in at least 4 of 5 outer folds
warm turn p95 <= 500 ms and failure rate is zero
promotion_gate.action_if_fail: Park query+dense interaction and retain it only as dependency evidence.
